gloss: to hold back; to stop by force

definitions.gloss: to hold back; to stop by force
definitions.explanation: To physically stop or restrain a person, movement, or action from continuing, typically by pushing against it or otherwise applying force.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}し{止|と}める。
examples.english: To hold the other person back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飛|と}び{出|だ}そう→飛び出す：02374_tobidasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}し{止|と}めた。
examples.english: I held back the child who was about to dash out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警備員|けいびいん}→警備員：09867_keibiin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{群衆|ぐんしゅう}→群衆：14930_gunshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{門|もん}→門：14603_mon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{押|お}し{止|と}めた。
examples.english: The guards held the crowd back in front of the gate.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Transitive ichidan verb. X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}し{止|と}める. A compound of ⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧ (to push) and ⟦{止|と}める→止める：00678_tomeru⟧ (to stop), so it implies stopping something by pushing against it or holding it in place.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{群衆|ぐんしゅう}→群衆：14930_gunshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}し{止|と}める: to hold back a crowd
- ⟦{勢|いきお}い→勢い：01782_ikioi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}し{止|と}める: to check the momentum of something

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{食|く}い{止|と}める→食い止める：06384_kuitomeru⟧: to check; to hold in check — stresses preventing spread or worsening, often figurative
- ⟦{引|ひ}き{止|と}める→引き止める：06166_hikitomeru⟧: to hold back; to detain — stops someone from leaving, often by persuasion
